name: Inukai Yuki
source:
“You’re such a bad boy, troubling mom like that… But please, please I beg you, don’t go anywhere, okay? Please stay by mom’s side forever.” 

The mother of [url=https://vndb.org/c57566]Tsukasa[/url]. A wise mother who, despite all the hardships of her divorce, managed to run her real estate business while raising her child all by herself. Her calm and gentle demeanor is well-liked among the residents of the shopping district.

Despite her pride of raising her Tsukasa as a fine man, she feels bad for making him experience loneliness back when he was still a child. Currently, she keeps a moderate distance while watching over Tsukasa. However, deep within her heart, she feels a sense of loss and vague unease as she sees her son grow up to be capable of independence. 

After her experience with her ex-husband, she doesn't have any intention of remarrying. Still, her matured body tingles with sexual desire from time to time. 

[Translated from [url=http://cattleyasoft.com/cat06/character.html]Official Site[/url]]
